text:
SS & PS | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by 
 Y1 in the titled block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, 
 ... etc.
Current transformer must be isolated and proper grounding is required
Wear your safety 
 belt because there is a danger of falling off the top of the CT stack when cleaning
 insulators or checking connections.
Presence the safety 
 supervisor is required.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc
Tool set for tightness, 
 Fiberglass ladder, Silicagel
Cleaning tools as cloth, rags .... etc
Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc
Voltage indicator.
Work to be carried out
In addition to the 2 monthly inspection check list, carry
 out the following steps:
Check out the condition of the expansion diaphragm
Open secondary terminal compartment, blow out compartment
 and check the condition of the weather seal
Check that all wiring terminations are tight and securely
 fastened
Check the condition of cables or conduits entering the
 secondary terminal compartment
Check earth bus connections to base of CT for tightness.
Do touch up painting if required.
